extracted.intended_audience: Users of Singular's gfan.lib and polymake.lib (mathematicians / computational algebraists wanting to compute with cones, fans, and polytopes)
extracted.subtask_description: Reference of procedures in Singular's gfan.lib and polymake.lib for constructing and querying cones, fans, and polytopes (usage, return types, flags, and important notes). Intended to guide interactive use and scripting within Singular for polyhedral computations.

rubrics_metrics.name: flags behavior for inequality/equation-based constructors
rubrics_metrics.description: Flags may range between 0..3 defining an upper and lower bit (0=0*2+0, 1=0*2+1, 2=1*2+0, 3=1*2+1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the higher bit is 1, the program assumes each inequality yields a facet. If the lower bit is 1, the program assumes the kernel of E is the span of the cone. If either bit is 0 then the program computes the information itself. (This note is applied to routines such as polytopeViaInequalities and similar constructors.)

rubrics_metrics.name: coneLink
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: coneLink(c,w); c cone, w intvec/bigintmat. Return: cone, the link of c around w.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example shows creating a cone from points and computing the link around rays or vectors; use rays() and generatorsOfLinealitySpace() to inspect results.

rubrics_metrics.name: containsAsFace
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: containsAsFace(c,d); c cone, d cone. Return: 1 if d is a face of c; 0 otherwise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example demonstrates difference between containsInSupport and containsAsFace: a subset may be in the support but not a face.

rubrics_metrics.name: containsInSupport
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: containsInSupport(c,d); c cone, d cone or containsInSupport(c,p); c cone, p intvec/bigintmat. Return: 1 if d (resp. p) is contained in c; 0 otherwise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show checking containment of cones and integer vectors in a cone.

rubrics_metrics.name: containsPositiveVector
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: containsPositiveVector(c); c cone. Return: 1 if c contains a vector with only positive entries in its relative interior; 0 otherwise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example shows testing concrete cones to determine whether a strictly positive interior vector exists.

rubrics_metrics.name: containsRelatively
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: containsRelatively(c,p); c cone, intvec p. Return: 1 iff the given cone contains the given point in its relative interior; 0 otherwise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example checks points that lie in the relative interior versus boundary of a cone.

rubrics_metrics.name: convexHull
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: convexHull(c1,c2) or variants mixing cones and polytopes. Return: cone resp polytope, the convex hull of the two input objects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show convex hull of cones/polytopes and how to inspect returned AMBIENT_DIM, FACETS, LINEAR_SPAN, and rays.

rubrics_metrics.name: convexIntersection
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: convexIntersection(c1,c2) or variants mixing cones and polytopes. Return: cone resp polytope, the convex intersection of the two input objects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show returned facets and rays for intersections; same type-mixing as convexHull applies.

rubrics_metrics.name: dimension
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: dimension(c); c cone; dimension(f); f fan; dimension(p); p polytope. Return: int, the dimension of the input.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example shows dimension of cones, placement into fans, and that an empty fan reports -1 until cones inserted.

rubrics_metrics.name: dualCone
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: dualCone(c); c cone. Return: cone, the dual of c.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show returned INEQUALITIES and rays for dual cones; inspect print(rays(...)) for generators.

rubrics_metrics.name: equations
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: equations(c); c cone or equations(p); p polytope. Return: bigintmat, defining equations of c resp p.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: neither unique nor complete, unless c resp p in canonical form. Examples show returned equation matrices or empty output when none.

rubrics_metrics.name: faceContaining
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: faceContaining(c,w); c cone, w intvec/bigintmat. Assume containsInSupport(c,w)==1. Return: cone, the face of c containing w in its relative interior.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show different returned faces depending on the point provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: facets
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: facets(c); c cone or facets(p); p polytope. Return: bigintmat, the facets of c resp p.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show facet matrices for concrete cones/polytopes.

rubrics_metrics.name: generatorsOfLinealitySpace
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: generatorsOfLinealitySpace(c); c cone. Return: bigintmat, generators of the lineality space of c.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example prints the integer generators of the lineality space for a cone that has nontrivial lineality.

rubrics_metrics.name: generatorsOfSpan
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: generatorsOfSpan(c); c cone. Return: bigintmat, generators of the span of c.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example shows returned generators for span in higher ambient dimension.

rubrics_metrics.name: getLinearForms
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: getLinearForms(c); c cone or getLinearForms(p); p polytope. Return: bigintmat, linear forms previously stored in c resp p.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: setLinearForms(c,v) stores linear forms; getLinearForms retrieves them. Example shows get before and after setLinearForms.

rubrics_metrics.name: getMultiplicity
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: getMultiplicity(c); c cone or getMultiplicity(p); p polytope. Return: bigint, 1 or a multiplicity previously stored in c resp p.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use setMultiplicity(c,k) to store multiplicity; getMultiplicity retrieves it. Example demonstrates default 1 and retrieval after setting.

rubrics_metrics.name: inequalities
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: inequalities(c); c cone or inequalities(p); p polytope. Return: bigintmat, the inequalities of c resp p.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: neither unique nor irredundant, unless c resp p in canonical form. Examples show printed inequality matrices.

rubrics_metrics.name: isFullSpace
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: isFullSpace(c); c cone. Return: 1 if c is the entire ambient space; 0 otherwise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: default empty cone is full space; some constructed cones tested for being full ambient space.

rubrics_metrics.name: isOrigin
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: isOrigin(c); c cone. Return: 1 if c is the origin; 0 otherwise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples compare origin cone and cones generated by points.

rubrics_metrics.name: isSimplicial
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: isSimplicial(c); c cone or isSimplicial(f); f fan. Return: 1 if c resp f is simplicial; 0 otherwise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show simplicial and non-simplicial cones/fans; for fans result depends on all cones inserted.

rubrics_metrics.name: linealityDimension
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: linealityDimension(c); c cone or linealityDimension(f); f fan. Return: int, the dimension of the lineality space of c resp f.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show cones with zero or positive lineality dimension.

rubrics_metrics.name: linealitySpace
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: linealitySpace(c); c cone. Return: cone, the lineality space of c.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example returns cone representing the full lineality space (with LINEAR_SPAN equal to basis vectors).

rubrics_metrics.name: negatedCone
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: negatedCone(c); c cone. Return: cone, the negative of c.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example prints rays of the negated cone to show sign inversion.

rubrics_metrics.name: polytopeViaInequalities
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: polytopeViaInequalities(EV [, E [, flags]]); intmat EV,E, int flags. Return: polytope consisting of all points x such that IE*x >= 0 in each component and (if stated) E*x = 0.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Flags semantics (0..3) apply: higher bit -> assume each inequality yields a facet; lower bit -> assume kernel of E is span of cone. If bits are 0, program computes information itself. Examples show constructing a polytope with equations and inequalities and printed AMBIENT_DIM, INEQUALITIES, and EQUATIONS.

rubrics_metrics.name: polytopeViaPoints
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: polytopeViaPoints(V [, flags]); intmat V, int flags. Return: polytope which is the intersection of the cone generated by the row vectors of V with the hyperplane where the first coordinate equals 1.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Flags may be 0 or 1: if flags is 1 program assumes each row vector of M generates a ray in the cone; if 0 the program computes that info itself. Examples illustrate several polytopes including rational coordinates (scaled to integers) and the positive orthant (unbounded).

rubrics_metrics.name: quotientLatticeBasis
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: quotientLatticeBasis(c); c cone. Return: bigintmat, a basis of Z^n intersected with the span of c modulo Z^n intersected with the lineality space of c.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example prints the basis for a cone with given generating rows.

rubrics_metrics.name: randomPoint
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: randomPoint(c); c cone. Return: bigintmat, a random point in the relative interior of c.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example returns a large integer vector produced as a sample interior point.

rubrics_metrics.name: rays
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: rays(c); c cone. Return: bigintmat, generators of the rays of c, orthogonal to its lineality space.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show returned ray generators and effect of lineality on the ray list.

rubrics_metrics.name: relativeInteriorPoint
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: relativeInteriorPoint(c); c cone. Return: bigintmat, a point in the relative interior of c.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: not unique, unless c is in its canonical form. Examples show returned small integer interior points.

rubrics_metrics.name: semigroupGenerator
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: semigroupGenerator(c); c cone. Return: bigintmat, the generator of Z^n intersected with c modulo Z^n intersected with the lineality space of c. Assume dimension(c) == linealityDimension(c)+1.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example demonstrates semigroup generator for a one-dimensional quotient cone.

rubrics_metrics.name: setLinearForms
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: setLinearForms(c); c cone or setLinearForms(p); p polytope. Return: none, stores linear forms in c resp p.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use getLinearForms to retrieve stored linear forms. Example shows writing and reading linear forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: setMultiplicity
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: setMultiplicity(c); c cone or setMultiplicity(p); p polytope. Return: none, stores a multiplicity in c resp p.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use getMultiplicity to query multiplicity. Example shows default multiplicity 1 and changing to 3.

rubrics_metrics.name: span
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: span(c); c cone. Return: bigintmat, unique irredundant equations of c.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: name chosen to align with polymake nomenclature. Example prints unique irredundant equations (e.g., constraints that define ambient coordinates).

rubrics_metrics.name: uniquePoint
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: uniquePoint(c); c cone. Return: bigintmat, a unique point in c stable under reflections at coordinate hyperplanes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example shows behavior for cones symmetric under coordinate reflections; returns a canonical representative point.

rubrics_metrics.name: containsInCollection
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: containsInCollection(f,c); f fan, c cone. Return: 1 if f contains c; 0 otherwise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Typical pattern: create emptyFan, insertCone, then use containsInCollection to test membership. Examples show 0 before insertion and 1 after.

rubrics_metrics.name: emptyFan
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: emptyFan(n); n int. Return: fan, an empty fan in ambient dimension n.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example prints properties of the created fan: AMBIENT_DIM, DIM as -1 initially, LINEALITY_DIM, RAYS empty etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: fanViaCones
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: fanViaCones(L) or fanViaCones(c1,...,ck); list or cones. Return: fan, creates a fan generated by the cones in L resp c1,...,ck.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show creating fans from cone lists and inspection of RAYS, F_VECTOR, SIMPLICIAL, PURE, CONES, and MAXIMAL_CONES fields.

rubrics_metrics.name: fullFan
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: fullFan(n); n int. Return: fan, a full fan in ambient dimension n.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example shows a 'full' fan with certain LINEALITY_SPACE and F_VECTOR fields; CONES may be empty sets for some representations.

rubrics_metrics.name: fVector
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: fVector(f); f fan. Return: bigintmat, the f-Vector of f.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: empty fan returns empty; after inserting cones fVector reports counts of faces by dimension (e.g., 1,2,1).

rubrics_metrics.name: getCone
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: getCone(f,d,i[,o,m]); f fan, d int, i int, o int, m int. Return: cone, returns in the fan f of all cones in dimension d the i-th cone. If o=1 enumerate over cone orbits (deactivated for now); if m=1 enumerate over maximal cones.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assume d between 0 and ambientDimension(f), i between 1 and numberOfConesOfDimension(...). Examples show retrieving cones and inspecting FACETS and LINEAR_SPAN.

rubrics_metrics.name: insertCone
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: insertCone(f,c[,b]); f fan, c cone, b int. Assume isCompatible(f,c)=1. Return: none, inserts the cone c into f. If b=0, skip compatibility check.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show constructing emptyFan, inserting a cone, and observing changed fan properties (DIM, RAYS, F_VECTOR, CONES, MAXIMAL_CONES).

rubrics_metrics.name: isCompatible
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: isCompatible(f,c); f fan, c cone. Return: 1 if f and c live in same ambient space and intersection of c with any cone of f is a face of each; 0 otherwise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples demonstrate compatibility failing when cones overlap improperly, and succeeding for cones aligned with fan structure.

rubrics_metrics.name: isPure
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: isPure(f); f fan. Return: 1 if all maximal cones of f are of the same dimension; 0 otherwise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show fullFan yields pure; inserting cones of varying maximal dimensions can make isPure return 0.

rubrics_metrics.name: nmaxcones
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: nmaxcones(f); f fan. Return: int, the number of maximal cones in f.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show count changes after insertCone operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: ncones
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: ncones(f); f fan. Return: int, the number of cones in f.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show number of cones in fan increases with inserted cones and their faces.

rubrics_metrics.name: numberOfConesOfDimension
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: numberOfConesOfDimension(f,d[,o,m]); f fan, d int, o int, m int. Assume d between 0 and ambientDimension(f). Return: number of cones in f of dimension d. If o=1 count cone orbits (deactivated); if m=1 count only maximal cones.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples query counts for various dimensions and optional flags.

rubrics_metrics.name: removeCone
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: removeCone(f,c[,b]); f fan, c cone, b int. Assume containsInCollection(f,c)=1. Return: none, removes the cone c from f. If b=0 skip containment check.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example shows removing a cone updates RAYS, N_RAYS, F_VECTOR, and CONES accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: dualPolytope
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: dualPolytope(p); p polytope. Return: polytope, the dual of p.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example prints AMBIENT_DIM and INEQUALITIES of the dual polytope.

rubrics_metrics.name: newtonPolytope
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: newtonPolytope(f); f poly. Return: polytope, the convex hull of all exponent vectors of f.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example uses a polynomial ring and polynomial f=x+y+z to compute Newton polytope; returned INEQUALITIES and EQUATIONS include affine hull info.

rubrics_metrics.name: vertices
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: vertices(p); p polytope. Return: bigintmat, the vertices of p modulo its lineality space.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example shows list of vertices (as integer rows) for a constructed polytope; lineality space quotienting affects output.

rubrics_metrics.name: polymake.lib warning and purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: polymake.lib is an interface to polymake and TOPCOM for computations with polytopes and fans and requires external programs installed (and works only on Linux). The library's conventions for polytopes/fans may differ from polymake's native conventions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Warning: Most procedures will not work unless polymake or topcom is installed and they only work on Linux. The library is an interface that exposes a limited number of polymake/topcom options and adapts them for use in Singular; users should prefer polymake.so when available.

rubrics_metrics.name: polymakePolytope
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage: polymakePolytope(points); points intmat. Purpose/Return: calls polymake to compute vertices, dimension and facet/graph info of the polytope given by lattice points rows.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns a list L with: L[1] = integer matrix of vertex coordinates; L[2] = dimension; L[3] = adjacency list for vertex-edge graph; L[4] = bigintmat giving linear equations of the affine hull (rows multiplied by (1,var(1),...,var(nvar))). Notes: requires polymake installed. Vertex indexing differs from polymake's zero-based convention (Singular here starts at one).
